evidence.quote: May the agent pay without asking again: yes

purchaseAuthorized.note: The mandate explicitly allows the agent to pay without asking again.

itemMatchesMandate.note: The mandate asks only for a non-stick frying pan, 10-inch. The order also contains a silicone spatula set, which the mandate does not ask for.

quantityMatchesMandate.note: The mandate asks for a quantity of 1. The order contains 2 units in total: one pan and one spatula set.

withinSpendingLimit.note: The order total of $31.98 is within the $35.00 spending limit.

exclusionsRespected.note: The mandate lists no exclusions, so nothing can be excluded.

evidence.quote: Charged $31.98, identical to the cart received.

storeChargedAsOrdered.note: The store charged the same total as the cart the agent submitted.

evidence.quote: Shipped: 1 x Non-Stick Frying Pan, 10-inch; 1 x Silicone Spatula Set, 3-piece.

storeFulfilledAsOrdered.note: The store shipped the same two items that the order contains.

verdict.reason: The agent added a silicone spatula set that the mandate did not ask for, so the order differs from the approved mandate in item and quantity. The store charged and shipped what was ordered, so the store is not at fault, and the buyer did not approve this order, so the buyer is not responsible.
